name: pingy
description: Pingy — Get notified when your AI coding agent needs you. Works with Cursor and Claude Code. Your AI coding agent's little notification buddy.

commands.title: Pingy: Run Setup (once for all agents and projects)

cursorping.serverUrl.description: ntfy server base URL (use your self-hosted instance if preferred)

cursorping.waitingAfterMs.description: Cursor only: how long a shell or MCP gate must stay open before it counts as Cursor waiting for your approval. Cursor fires its gate events whether or not you are asked, so a short window turns ordinary auto-run commands into false "waiting" alerts. Lower it only if you never use auto-run.

cursorping.alertOnUnconfirmedShellWaits.description: Cursor only: send a waiting alert for a shell command even when terminal activity cannot confirm the command is not running. Off by default because a long auto-run command (install, build, test suite) looks exactly like a pending approval. Turn it on if you never use auto-run and would rather have the alert.

cursorping.pendingTimeoutMs.deprecationMessage: Superseded by cursorping.waitingAfterMs — this no longer affects waiting alerts.
cursorping.pendingTimeoutMs.description: Deprecated. Kept so existing settings do not error; use cursorping.waitingAfterMs instead.

cursorping.pendingMaxAgeMs.description: Milliseconds after which an unresolved gate is treated as abandoned (Cursor restarted, agent crashed) instead of waiting

cursorping.waitingRepingMs.description: Claude Code only: how long one "your agent needs you" push covers a session. Claude Code raises a notification for every approval dialog, so repeats inside this window are suppressed. Lower it if you want a ping for each prompt.

cursorping.watcherIntervalMs.description: How often the extension polls pending-approval state
